global: This shoyu ramen features a clear, amber broth with tender chashu pork, nori, menma, and naruto fish cake arranged atop. Served in a white bowl with “絹屋” branding, it rests on a dark tray under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and black Japanese characters with red seal mark.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and seaweed, golden-brown, glossy, and steaming hot.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, slightly curled, with a rough, uneven surface and visible texture from its dried, layered structure.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with golden-brown sear, curved shape, and visible marbling on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curved, segmented shapes.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale beige, slightly translucent, oval-shaped with pink and green swirls on its surface.
